# Cncf Gocrane Reviewer

Review gocrane using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Continuous Optimization category. Crane (FinOps Crane) is an opensource project which manages cloud resource on Kubernetes stack, it is inspired by FinOps concepts.
